The last four parameters are optional and default to the standard encoding characters. @param {XML} node - The E4X XML node to deserialize. @param {String} fieldSeparator - Defaults to '|' if not specified. @param {String} componentSeparator - Defaults to '^' if not specified. @param {String} repetitionMarker - Defaults to '~' if not specified. @param {String} subcomponentSeparator - Defaults to '&' if not specified. @return {String} The deserialized HL7 v2.x string. */ function xmlToHL7(node, fieldSeparator, componentSeparator, repetitionMarker, subcomponentSeparator) { // Data validation if (!node) { return ''; } // This shouldn't really ever happen with E4X anyway, but just in case. String.prototype.replaceAmp = function() {return this.replace(/&/g,'&');}; // If we're just dealing with a simple node, then just return its contents. if (node.hasSimpleContent()) { return node.toString().replaceAmp(); } // Used for StringUtils importPackage(org.apache.commons.lang3); // Defaults to standard HL7 encoding characters var fs = fieldSeparator || '|'; var cs = componentSeparator || '^'; var rm = repetitionMarker || '~'; var ss = subcomponentSeparator || '&'; var cr = '\x0D'; // What will actually be returned var output = ''; // Get the XML name of the node (in the case of an XMLList of repeating fields, the first one will be returned, since they all have the same name anyway) var qname = node[0].name().toString(); // Use the HL7 dot notation to find what level we're at var level = StringUtils.countMatches(qname,'.'); // If the name is HL7Message, we're at the root node if (qname == 'HL7Message') { // Recursively append serialization for each segment for each (segment in node.children()) { output += xmlToHL7(segment,fs,cs,rm,ss); } } else if (level == 0) { // If we're at the segment level // If the node is an XMLList of multiple segments if (node.length() > 1) { // Recursively append serialization for each segment for each (segment in node) { output += xmlToHL7(segment,fs,cs,rm,ss); } } else { // Add the segment name to the output output += qname; // Initialize name placeholder var prevName = ''; // Iterate through each field in the segment for each (field in node.children()) { // Get the QName of the field var fieldName = field.name().toString(); // If we're dealing with the special cases of MSH.1/2, then just add the field contents if (fieldName in {'MSH.1':1,'MSH.2':1}) { output += field.toString().replaceAmp(); } else { // Otherwise add the recursive serialization of the field // If we're on a field repetition, then prepend a repetition marker, otherwise prepend a field separator output += (prevName==fieldName?rm:fs) + xmlToHL7(field,fs,cs,rm,ss); } // Update the field name placeholder prevName = fieldName; } // Add a carriage return to the end of the segment output += cr; } } else if (level == 1) { // If we're at the field level // If the node is an XMLList of multiple fields if (node.length() > 1) { // Recursively append serialization for each field for each (field in node) { output += xmlToHL7(field,fs,cs,rm,ss) + rm; } // Remove the final repetition marker output = StringUtils.chomp(output,rm); } else { // Recursively append serialization for each component for each (component in node.children()) { // Append a component separator to the end output += xmlToHL7(component,fs,cs,rm,ss) + cs; } // Remove the last component separator output = StringUtils.chomp(output,cs); } } else if (level == 2) { // If we're at the component level // Recursively append serialization for each subcomponent for each (subcomponent in node.children()) { // Append a subcomponent separator to the end output += xmlToHL7(subcomponent,fs,cs,rm,ss) + ss; } // Remove the last subcomponent separator output = StringUtils.chomp(output,ss); } else { // If we're at the subcomponent level // Just add the contents of the node output = node.toString().replaceAmp(); } // Return the final output return output; }

	the PDF.
	
	See also:
	https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/pdfbox/cmssite/trunk/content/docs/1.8.4/javadocs/org/apache/pdfbox/pdmodel/PDDocument.html

	@param {byte[]} pdfBytes - The raw PDF byte array.
	@return {Number} The number of pages in the PDF.
*/
function getNumPagesInPDF(pdfBytes) {
	var is = new java.io.ByteArrayInputStream(pdfBytes);

				<include name="**/*.jar" />
			</fileset>

<!--		<ant antfile="${core.client.api}/build.xml" dir="${core.client.api}" target="test-run"/> -->
<!--		<ant antfile="${core.client}/build.xml" dir="${core.client}" target="test-run"/> -->
		<ant antfile="${core.server.plugins}/build.xml" dir="${core.server.plugins}" target="test-run"/>
<!--		<ant antfile="${core.ui}/build.xml" dir="${core.ui}" target="test-run"/> -->
<!--		<ant antfile="${core.client.plugins}/build.xml" dir="${core.client.plugins}" target="test-run"/> -->
		<ant antfile="${donkey}/build.xml" dir="${donkey}" target="test-run"/>
		<ant antfile="${server}/build.xml" dir="${server}" target="test-run"/>
		<ant antfile="${client}/ant-build.xml" dir="${client}" target="test-run"/>

</project>

		<delete>
			<fileset dir="${setup}" includes="**/.svn" />
		</delete>
		
		<taskdef resource="net/sf/antcontrib/antlib.xml" classpathref="classpath" />

		<!-- modify jar manifests -->
		<!-- don't modify bcprov, since it already has the manifest changes and is signed by BC -->
		<echo message="[Thread Count: ${manifest_thread_count}] Modifying jar manifests to add Permissions: all-permissions; Codebase: *; Application-Name: Mirth Connect" />
		<for param="jarFile" parallel="true" threadCount="${manifest_thread_count}">
	    	<fileset dir="${setup.client.lib}" includes="**/*.jar" excludes="bcp*.jar,bcutil*.jar"/>
	    	<fileset dir="${setup.extensions}" includes="**/*.jar" />
			<sequential>
				<apply executable="jar">
			        <arg value="umf" />
			        <arg line="custom_manifest.mf" />
			        <srcfile />
			    	<fileset file="@{jarFile}"/>
			    </apply>
			</sequential>
		</for>

		<!-- sign jars for webstart -->
		<echo message="[Thread Count: ${signjar_thread_count}] Signing jars for Java Web Start" />
		<property file="${keystore_property_file}" />
		
		<for param="jarFile" parallel="true" threadCount="${signjar_thread_count}">
			<fileset dir="${setup.client.lib}" includes="**/*.jar" />
			<fileset dir="${setup.extensions}" includes="**/*.jar" />
			<sequential>
				<retry retrycount="5" retrydelay="1000">
					<signjar jar="@{jarFile}" alias="${key.alias}" keystore="${key.keystore}" storepass="${key.storepass}" keypass="${key.keypass}" storetype="${key.storetype}" tsaurl="http://sha256timestamp.ws.symantec.com/sha256/timestamp" digestalg="SHA-256">
						<!-- http://bugs.sun.com/bugdatabase/view_bug.do?bug_id=7127374 -->
						<sysproperty key="jsse.enableSNIExtension" value="false" />
						<sysproperty key="https.protocols" value="TLSv1.2,TLSv1.1" />
					</signjar>
				</retry>
			</sequential>
		</for>
	</target>

<!-- 
	Database driver information
	class = the driver class name, cannot be empty
	name = database driver name to be displayed as, cannot be empty
	template = the template for creating the database connection, cannot be empty
	selectLimit = defines the select statement used for retrieving column information, empty means use the generic query (which could be slow)
	alternativeClasses = A comma-separated list of legacy driver classes (optional).
-->
<drivers>
	<driver class="com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver" name="MySQL" template="jdbc:mysql://host:port/dbname" selectLimit="SELECT * FROM ? LIMIT 1" alternativeClasses="com.mysql.jdbc.Driver" />
	<driver class="oracle.jdbc.driver.OracleDriver" name="Oracle" template="jdbc:oracle:thin:@host:port:dbname" selectLimit="SELECT * FROM ? WHERE ROWNUM < 2" />
	<driver class="org.postgresql.Driver" name="PostgreSQL" template="jdbc:postgresql://host:port/dbname" selectLimit="SELECT * FROM ? LIMIT 1" />
	<driver class="net.sourceforge.jtds.jdbc.Driver" name="SQL Server/Sybase (jTDS)" template="jdbc:jtds:sqlserver://host:port/dbname" selectLimit="SELECT TOP 1 * FROM ?" />
	<driver class="com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.SQLServerDriver" name="Microsoft SQL Server" template="jdbc:sqlserver://host:port;databaseName=dbname" selectLimit="SELECT TOP 1 * FROM ?" />
	<driver class="org.sqlite.JDBC" name="SQLite" template="jdbc:sqlite:dbfile.db" selectLimit="SELECT * FROM ? LIMIT 1" />
</drivers>

			RECEIVED_DATE,
			PROCESSED,
			ORIGINAL_ID,
			IMPORT_CHANNEL_ID,
			IMPORT_ID

		FROM D_M${localChannelId}
		<where>
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				AND ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
		</where>
		ORDER BY ID DESC
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageById" resultMap="message">
		SELECT
			ID,
			SERVER_ID,
			RECEIVED_DATE,
			PROCESSED,
			ORIGINAL_ID,
			IMPORT_ID,
			IMPORT_CHANNEL_ID

		FROM D_M${localChannelId}
		WHERE ID = #{messageId}
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageContent" resultMap="messageContent">
		SELECT *
		FROM D_MC${localChannelId}
		WHERE MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}
		AND METADATA_ID IN
		<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="metaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
			#{metaDataId}
		</foreach>
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageAttachmentIds" parameterType="map" resultType="Attachment">
		SELECT ID, TYPE FROM D_MA${localChannelId}
		WHERE MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}
		GROUP BY ID, TYPE
	</select>
	
	
	
	<!-- Data Pruner -->
	
	<delete id="pruneMessages" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_M${localChannelId} M
		
		<where>
			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
			
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
		</where>
	</delete>
	
	<delete id="pruneMessageContent" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_MC${localChannelId} M
		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>
	
	<delete id="pruneAttachments" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_MA${localChannelId} M
		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>
	
	<sql id="pruneWhere">
		<where>
			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				MESSAGE_ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
			
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
		</where>
	</sql>

	<select id="getMessagesToPrune" parameterType="map" resultMap="pruner-message-map">
		SELECT
			M.ID,
			MM.RECEIVED_DATE AS MM_RECEIVED_DATE

		FROM D_M${localChannelId} M
		JOIN D_MM${localChannelId} MM ON MM.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID AND MM.ID = 0
		
		<if test="skipStatuses != null">
			LEFT JOIN D_MM${localChannelId} MM_SKIP ON MM_SKIP.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID AND MM_SKIP.STATUS IN
			<foreach item="status" collection="skipStatuses" open="(" separator="," close=")">
				#{status}
			</foreach>
		</if>
	
		WHERE MM.RECEIVED_DATE <![CDATA[ < ]]> #{dateThreshold}
		
		<if test="maxMessageId != null">
			AND M.ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
		</if>
		
		<if test="minMessageId != null">
			AND M.ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
		</if>
		
		<if test="skipIncomplete == true">
			AND M.PROCESSED = TRUE
		</if>
		
		<if test="skipStatuses != null">
			AND MM_SKIP.ID IS NULL
		</if>
		
		ORDER BY M.ID

		<if test="limit != null">
			LIMIT #{limit}
		</if>
	</select>
	
	<update id="pruneEvents" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM EVENT
		WHERE DATE_CREATED <![CDATA[ < ]]> #{dateThreshold}
	</update>
</mapper>

			</if>
			
			<if test="textSearch != null">
				AND 
				
				<foreach item="column" collection="textSearchMetaDataColumns" open="(" separator=" OR " close=")">
					<choose>
						<when test="textSearchRegex == null || textSearchRegex == false">
							"${column}" LIKE '%' || #{textSearch} || '%'
						</when>
						<otherwise>
							REGEXP_LIKE("${column}", #{textSearch})
						</otherwise>
					</choose>
				</foreach>
			</if>
			
			<if test="metaDataSearch != null">
				<foreach item="element" collection="metaDataSearch">
					AND 
					
					<choose>
						<when test="element.ignoreCase">
							UPPER("${element.columnName}")
						</when>
						<otherwise>
							"${element.columnName}"
						</otherwise>
					</choose>
					
					<choose>
						<when test="element.operator == 'EQUAL'">
							<![CDATA[ = ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'NOT_EQUAL'">
							<![CDATA[ != ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'LESS_THAN'">
							<![CDATA[ < ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL'">
							<![CDATA[ <= ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'GREATER_THAN'">
							<![CDATA[ > ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL'">
							<![CDATA[ >= ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'CONTAINS' || element.operator == 'STARTS_WITH' || element.operator == 'ENDS_WITH'">
							LIKE
						</when>						
						<when test="element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_CONTAIN' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_START_WITH' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_END_WITH'">
							NOT LIKE
						</when>
					</choose>
					
					<if test="element.operator == 'CONTAINS' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_CONTAIN' || element.operator == 'ENDS_WITH' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_END_WITH'">
						'%' ||
					</if>
					
					<choose>
						<when test="element.ignoreCase">
							UPPER(#{element.value})
						</when>
						<otherwise>
							#{element.value}
						</otherwise>
					</choose>
					
					<if test="element.operator == 'CONTAINS' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_CONTAIN' || element.operator == 'STARTS_WITH' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_START_WITH'">
						|| '%'
					</if>
				</foreach>
			</if>
		</where>
	</select>
	
	<select id="searchContentTable" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageTextResult">
		SELECT MESSAGE_ID AS MESSAGE_ID, METADATA_ID AS METADATA_ID, CONTENT_TYPE AS CONTENT_TYPE
			
		FROM D_MC${localChannelId}
		
		<where>
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="metaDataId != null">
				AND METADATA_ID = #{metaDataId}
			</if>
			<if test="contentType != null">
				AND CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType}
			</if>
			<foreach item="content" collection="contents">
				<choose>
					<when test="textSearchRegex == null || textSearchRegex == false">
						AND CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{content} || '%'
					</when>
					<otherwise>
						AND REGEXP_LIKE(CONTENT, #{content})
					</otherwise>
				</choose>
			</foreach>
		</where>
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessagesById" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageSearchResult">
		SELECT
			ID,
			SERVER_ID,
			RECEIVED_DATE,
			PROCESSED,
			ORIGINAL_ID,
			IMPORT_CHANNEL_ID,
			IMPORT_ID

		FROM D_M${localChannelId}
		<where>
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				AND ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
		</where>
		ORDER BY ID DESC
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageById" resultMap="message">
		SELECT 
			ID,
			SERVER_ID,
			RECEIVED_DATE,
			PROCESSED,
			ORIGINAL_ID,
			IMPORT_ID,
			IMPORT_CHANNEL_ID
			
		FROM D_M${localChannelId}
		WHERE ID = #{messageId}
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageContent" resultMap="messageContent">
		SELECT 
			METADATA_ID,
			MESSAGE_ID,
			CONTENT_TYPE,
			CONTENT,
			DATA_TYPE,
			IS_ENCRYPTED
			
		FROM D_MC${localChannelId}
		WHERE MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}
		AND METADATA_ID IN
		<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="metaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
			#{metaDataId}
		</foreach>
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageAttachmentIds" parameterType="map" resultType="Attachment">
		SELECT ID, TYPE FROM D_MA${localChannelId}
		WHERE MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}
		GROUP BY ID, TYPE
	</select>
	
	
	
	<!-- Data Pruner/Archiver -->
	
	<delete id="pruneMessages" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_M${localChannelId}
		
		<where> 
			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
			
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
		</where> 
	</delete>
	
	<delete id="pruneMessageContent" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_MC${localChannelId}
		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>
	
	<delete id="pruneAttachments" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_MA${localChannelId}
		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>
	
	<sql id="pruneWhere">
		<where>
			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				MESSAGE_ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
			
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
		</where>
	</sql>
	
	<select id="getMessagesToPrune" parameterType="map" resultMap="pruner-message-map">
		<if test="limit != null">
			SELECT A.* FROM (
		</if>

			SELECT
				M.ID,
				MM.RECEIVED_DATE AS MM_RECEIVED_DATE
			
			FROM D_M${localChannelId} M
			JOIN D_MM${localChannelId} MM ON MM.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID AND MM.ID = 0
			
			<if test="skipStatuses != null">
				LEFT JOIN D_MM${localChannelId} MM_SKIP ON MM_SKIP.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID AND MM_SKIP.STATUS IN
				<foreach item="status" collection="skipStatuses" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{status}
				</foreach>
			</if>
		
			WHERE MM.RECEIVED_DATE <![CDATA[ < ]]> #{dateThreshold}
			
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND M.ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				AND M.ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			
			<if test="skipIncomplete == true">
				AND M.PROCESSED = 1
			</if>
			
			<if test="skipStatuses != null">
				AND MM_SKIP.ID IS NULL
			</if>
			
			ORDER BY M.ID
		
		<if test="limit != null">
			) A WHERE ROWNUM <![CDATA[ <= ]]> ${limit}
		</if>
	</select>
	
	<update id="pruneEvents" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM EVENT
		WHERE DATE_CREATED <![CDATA[ < ]]> #{dateThreshold}
	</update>
</mapper>

<?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8'?><!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC '-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN' 'conf/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd'>

<mapper namespace="Message">
	<resultMap id="messageContent" type="com.mirth.connect.donkey.model.message.MessageContent">
		<id property="messageId" column="MESSAGE_ID" />
		<id property="metaDataId" column="METADATA_ID" />
		<result property="contentType" column="CONTENT_TYPE" typeHandler="com.mirth.connect.server.sqlmap.extensions.ContentTypeHandler" />
		<result property="content" column="CONTENT" />
		<result property="dataType" column="DATA_TYPE" />
		<result property="encrypted" column="IS_ENCRYPTED" />
	</resultMap>
	
	<resultMap id="messageSearchResult" type="MessageSearchResult">
		<result property="messageId" column="ID" />
		<result property="serverId" column="SERVER_ID" />
		<result property="receivedDate" column="RECEIVED_DATE" />
		<result property="processed" column="PROCESSED" />
		<result property="originalId" column="ORIGINAL_ID" />
		<result property="importId" column="IMPORT_ID" />
		<result property="importChannelId" column="IMPORT_CHANNEL_ID" />
		<result property="metaDataIds" column="METADATA_IDS" />
	</resultMap>
	
	<resultMap id="message" type="Message">
		<result property="messageId" column="ID" />
		<result property="serverId" column="SERVER_ID" />
		<result property="receivedDate" column="RECEIVED_DATE" />
		<result property="processed" column="PROCESSED" />
		<result property="originalId" column="ORIGINAL_ID" />
		<result property="importId" column="IMPORT_ID" />
		<result property="importChannelId" column="IMPORT_CHANNEL_ID" />
	</resultMap>
	
	<resultMap id="pruner-message-map" type="map">
		<result property="id" column="ID" javaType="Long" />
		<result property="server_id" column="SERVER_ID" javaType="String" />
		<result property="received_date" column="RECEIVED_DATE" javaType="java.util.Calendar" />
		<result property="mm_received_date" column="MM_RECEIVED_DATE" javaType="java.util.Calendar" />
		<result property="processed" column="PROCESSED" javaType="Boolean" />
		<result property="original_Id" column="ORIGINAL_ID" javaType="Long" />
		<result property="import_id" column="IMPORT_ID" javaType="Long" />
		<result property="import_channel_id" column="IMPORT_CHANNEL_ID" javaType="String" />
	</resultMap>
	
	<resultMap id="messageTextResult" type="MessageTextResult">
		<result property="messageId" column="MESSAGE_ID" />
		<result property="metaDataId" column="METADATA_ID" />
		<result property="contentType" column="CONTENT_TYPE" />
		<result property="textFound" column="TEXT_FOUND" />
		<result property="importId" column="IMPORT_ID" />
		<result property="processed" column="PROCESSED" />
	</resultMap>
	
	<select id="selectMessageForReprocessing" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageContent">
		SELECT MESSAGE_ID, METADATA_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, CONTENT, DATA_TYPE, IS_ENCRYPTED
		FROM D_MC${localChannelId}
		WHERE MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}
		AND METADATA_ID = 0
		AND CONTENT_TYPE IN (1, 15)
	</select>
	
	<select id="searchMessageTable" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageTextResult">
		SELECT ID AS MESSAGE_ID
			<if test="includeImportId != null">
				, IMPORT_ID
			</if>
			<if test="includeProcessed != null">
				, PROCESSED
			</if>
			
		FROM D_M${localChannelId} M
		<where>
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="originalIdLower != null">
				AND ORIGINAL_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{originalIdLower}
			</if>
			<if test="originalIdUpper != null">
				AND ORIGINAL_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{originalIdUpper}
			</if>
			<if test="importIdLower != null">
				AND IMPORT_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{importIdLower}
			</if>
			<if test="importIdUpper != null">
				AND IMPORT_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{importIdUpper}
			</if>
			<if test="startDate != null">
				AND RECEIVED_DATE <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{startDate}
			</if>
			<if test="endDate != null">
				AND RECEIVED_DATE <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{endDate}
			</if>
			<if test="serverId != null">
				AND UPPER(SERVER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{serverId}) || '%'
			</if>
			<if test="attachment != null and attachment == true">
				AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM D_MA${localChannelId} MA WHERE MA.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID)
			</if>
		</where>
	</select>
	
	<select id="searchMetaDataTable" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageTextResult">
		SELECT MESSAGE_ID AS MESSAGE_ID, ID AS METADATA_ID,
		<choose>
			<when test="textSearch != null">
				CASE WHEN UPPER(CONNECTOR_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{textSearch}) || '%' THEN TRUE
				ELSE FALSE
				END
			</when>
			<otherwise>
				FALSE
			</otherwise>
		</choose>
		AS TEXT_FOUND
			
		FROM D_MM${localChannelId}
		
		<where>
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="statuses != null">
				AND STATUS IN
				<foreach item="status" collection="statuses" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{status}
				</foreach>
			</if>
			<if test="includedMetaDataIds != null">
				AND ID IN
				<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="includedMetaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{metaDataId}
				</foreach>
			</if>
			<if test="excludedMetaDataIds != null">
				AND ID NOT IN
				<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="excludedMetaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{metaDataId}
				</foreach>
			</if>
			<if test="sendAttemptsLower != null">
				AND SEND_ATTEMPTS <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{sendAttemptsLower}
			</if>
			<if test="sendAttemptsUpper != null">
				AND SEND_ATTEMPTS <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{sendAttemptsUpper}
			</if>
			<if test="error != null and error == true">
				AND ERROR_CODE <![CDATA[ > ]]> 0
			</if>
		</where>
	</select>
	
	<select id="searchCustomMetaDataTable" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageTextResult">
		SELECT MESSAGE_ID AS MESSAGE_ID, METADATA_ID AS METADATA_ID
			
		FROM D_MCM${localChannelId}
		
		<where>
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="includedMetaDataIds != null">
				AND METADATA_ID IN
				<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="includedMetaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{metaDataId}
				</foreach>
			</if>
			<if test="excludedMetaDataIds != null">
				AND METADATA_ID NOT IN
				<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="excludedMetaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{metaDataId}
				</foreach>
			</if>
			
			<if test="textSearch != null">
				AND 
				
				<foreach item="column" collection="textSearchMetaDataColumns" open="(" separator=" OR " close=")">
					UPPER(${column}) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{textSearch}) || '%'
				</foreach>
			</if>
			
			<if test="metaDataSearch != null">
				<foreach item="element" collection="metaDataSearch">
					AND
					
					<choose>
						<when test="element.ignoreCase">
							UPPER(${element.columnName})
						</when>
						<otherwise>
							${element.columnName}
						</otherwise>
					</choose>
					
					<choose>
						<when test="element.operator == 'EQUAL'">
							<![CDATA[ = ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'NOT_EQUAL'">
							<![CDATA[ != ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'LESS_THAN'">
							<![CDATA[ < ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL'">
							<![CDATA[ <= ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'GREATER_THAN'">
							<![CDATA[ > ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL'">
							<![CDATA[ >= ]]> 
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'CONTAINS' || element.operator == 'STARTS_WITH' || element.operator == 'ENDS_WITH'">
							LIKE
						</when>
						<when test="element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_CONTAIN' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_START_WITH' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_END_WITH'">
							NOT LIKE
						</when>
					</choose>
					
					<if test="element.operator == 'CONTAINS' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_CONTAIN' || element.operator == 'ENDS_WITH' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_END_WITH'">
						'%' ||
					</if>
					
					<choose>
						<when test="element.ignoreCase">
							UPPER(#{element.value})
						</when>
						<otherwise>
							#{element.value}
						</otherwise>
					</choose>
						
					<if test="element.operator == 'CONTAINS' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_CONTAIN' || element.operator == 'STARTS_WITH' || element.operator == 'DOES_NOT_START_WITH'">
						|| '%'
					</if>	
				</foreach>
			</if>
		</where>
	</select>
	
	<select id="searchContentTable" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageTextResult">
		SELECT MESSAGE_ID AS MESSAGE_ID, METADATA_ID AS METADATA_ID, CONTENT_TYPE AS CONTENT_TYPE
			
		FROM D_MC${localChannelId}
		
		<where>
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="metaDataId != null">
				AND METADATA_ID = #{metaDataId}
			</if>
			<if test="contentType != null">
				AND CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType}
			</if>
			<foreach item="content" collection="contents">
				AND UPPER(CONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{content}) || '%'
			</foreach>
		</where>
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessagesById" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageSearchResult">
		SELECT
			ID,
			SERVER_ID,
			RECEIVED_DATE,
			PROCESSED,
			ORIGINAL_ID,
			IMPORT_CHANNEL_ID,
			IMPORT_ID

		FROM D_M${localChannelId}
		<where>
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				AND ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
		</where>
		ORDER BY ID DESC
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageById" resultMap="message">
		SELECT
			ID,
			SERVER_ID,
			RECEIVED_DATE,
			PROCESSED,
			ORIGINAL_ID,
			IMPORT_ID,
			IMPORT_CHANNEL_ID

		FROM D_M${localChannelId}
		WHERE ID = #{messageId}
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageContent" resultMap="messageContent">
		SELECT
			METADATA_ID,
			MESSAGE_ID,
			CONTENT_TYPE,
			CONTENT,
			DATA_TYPE,
			ENCRYPTED

		FROM D_MC${localChannelId}
		WHERE MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}
		AND METADATA_ID IN
		<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="metaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
			#{metaDataId}
		</foreach>
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageAttachmentIds" parameterType="map" resultType="Attachment">
		SELECT ID, TYPE FROM D_MA${localChannelId}
		WHERE MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}
		GROUP BY ID, TYPE
	</select>
	
	
	
	<!-- Data Pruner/Archiver -->
	
	<delete id="pruneMessages" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_M${localChannelId}
		<where>
			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
			
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
		</where>
	</delete>
	
	<delete id="pruneConnectorMessages" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_MM${localChannelId}
		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>

	<delete id="pruneMessageContent" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_MC${localChannelId}
		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>
	
	<delete id="pruneCustomMetaData" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_MCM${localChannelId}
		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>
	
	<delete id="pruneAttachments" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_MA${localChannelId}
		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>
	
	<sql id="pruneWhere">
		<where>
			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				MESSAGE_ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
			
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
		</where>
	</sql>
	
	<select id="getMessagesToPrune" parameterType="map" resultMap="pruner-message-map">
		SELECT
			M.ID,
			MM.RECEIVED_DATE AS MM_RECEIVED_DATE
			
		FROM D_M${localChannelId} M
		JOIN D_MM${localChannelId} MM ON MM.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID AND MM.ID = 0
		
		<if test="skipStatuses != null">
			LEFT JOIN D_MM${localChannelId} MM_SKIP ON MM_SKIP.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID AND MM_SKIP.STATUS IN
			<foreach item="status" collection="skipStatuses" open="(" separator="," close=")">
				#{status}
			</foreach>
		</if>
		
		WHERE MM.RECEIVED_DATE <![CDATA[ < ]]> #{dateThreshold}
		
		<if test="maxMessageId != null">
			AND M.ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
		</if>
		
		<if test="minMessageId != null">
			AND M.ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
		</if>
		
		<if test="skipIncomplete == true">
			AND M.PROCESSED = TRUE
		</if>
		
		<if test="skipStatuses != null">
			AND MM_SKIP.ID IS NULL
		</if>
		
		ORDER BY M.ID
		
		<if test="limit != null">
			FETCH FIRST ${limit} ROWS ONLY
		</if>
	</select>
	
	<update id="pruneEvents" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM EVENT
		WHERE DATE_CREATED <![CDATA[ < ]]> #{dateThreshold}
	</update>
</mapper>

instruction: Explain and reproduce this general integration code from server/dbconf/derby/derby-channel.xml

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC '-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN' 'conf/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd'>

<mapper namespace="Channel">
	<resultMap id="channel-serialized-data" type="map">
		<result property="id" column="ID" javaType="String" />
		<result property="channel" column="CHANNEL" javaType="String" />
	</resultMap>
	
	<resultMap id="channel-revision-data" type="map">
		<result property="id" column="ID" javaType="String" />
		<result property="revision" column="REVISION" javaType="Integer" />
	</resultMap>
		
	<resultMap id="group-revision-data" type="map">
		<result property="id" column="ID" javaType="String" />
		<result property="revision" column="REVISION" javaType="Integer" />
	</resultMap>
	
	<select id="getChannel" parameterType="String" resultType="com.mirth.connect.model.Channel">
		SELECT CHANNEL
		FROM CHANNEL
		WHERE ID = #{value}
	</select>
	
	<select id="getSerializedChannelData" resultMap="channel-serialized-data">
		SELECT ID, CHANNEL
		FROM CHANNEL
	</select>
	
	<update id="updateSerializedChannelData" parameterType="map">
		UPDATE CHANNEL
		SET CHANNEL = #{channel}
		WHERE ID = #{id}
	</update>
	
	<select id='getChannelRevision' resultMap='channel-revision-data'>
		SELECT ID, REVISION
		FROM CHANNEL WITH UR
	</select>
	
	<insert id='insertChannel' parameterType='map'>
		INSERT INTO
		CHANNEL (ID, NAME, REVISION, CHANNEL)
		VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{revision}, #{channel})
	</insert>
	
	<update id='updateChannel' parameterType='map'>
		UPDATE CHANNEL
		SET NAME = #{name},
		REVISION = #{revision},
		CHANNEL = #{channel}
		WHERE ID = #{id}
	</update>
	
	<delete id='deleteChannel' parameterType='String'>
		DELETE FROM CHANNEL
		<where>
			<if test='value != null'>ID=#{value}</if>
		</where>
	</delete>
	
	<update id="lockChannelTable">
		LOCK TABLE CHANNEL IN EXCLUSIVE MODE
	</update>
	
	<select id="vacuumChannelTable" statementType="CALLABLE">
		{call SYSCS_UTIL.SYSCS_COMPRESS_TABLE('APP', 'CHANNEL', 0)}
	</select>
	
	<select id='getChannelGroup' parameterType="String" resultType="com.mirth.connect.model.ChannelGroup">
		SELECT CHANNEL_GROUP
		FROM CHANNEL_GROUP
		WHERE ID = #{value}
	</select>
	
	<select id='getChannelGroupRevision' resultMap='group-revision-data'>
		SELECT ID, REVISION
		FROM CHANNEL_GROUP WITH UR
	</select>
	
	<insert id='insertChannelGroup' parameterType='map'>
		INSERT INTO
		CHANNEL_GROUP (ID, NAME, REVISION, CHANNEL_GROUP)
		VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{revision}, #{channelGroup})
	</insert>
	
	<update id="updateChannelGroup" parameterType="map">
		UPDATE CHANNEL_GROUP
		SET NAME = #{name},
		REVISION = #{revision},
		CHANNEL_GROUP = #{channelGroup}
		WHERE ID = #{id}
	</update>
	
	<delete id='deleteChannelGroup' parameterType='String'>
		DELETE FROM CHANNEL_GROUP
		<where>
			<if test='value != null'>ID=#{value}</if>
		</where>
	</delete>
	
	<update id="lockChannelGroupTable">
		LOCK TABLE CHANNEL_GROUP IN EXCLUSIVE MODE
	</update>

	<select id="vacuumChannelGroupTable" statementType="CALLABLE">
		{call SYSCS_UTIL.SYSCS_COMPRESS_TABLE('APP', 'CHANNEL_GROUP', 0)}
	</select>
</mapper>

instruction: Explain and reproduce this general integration code from server/dbconf/derby/derby-event.xml
output:
<?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8'?><!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC '-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN' 'conf/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd'>
<mapper namespace='Event'>
   <resultMap id='event' type='com.mirth.connect.model.ServerEvent'>
      <result property='id' column='ID'/>
      <result property='eventTime' column='DATE_CREATED'/>
      <result property='level' column='EVENT_LEVEL'/>
      <result property='outcome' column='OUTCOME'/>
      <result property='name' column='NAME'/>
      <result property='attributes' column='ATTRIBUTES' typeHandler='MapTypeHandler'/>
      <result property='userId' column='USER_ID'/>
      <result property='ipAddress' column='IP_ADDRESS'/>
      <result property='serverId' column='SERVER_ID'/>
   </resultMap>
   
   <sql id='searchEventsBody'>
	  <where>
	  	 <if test='maxEventId != null'>AND ID <= #{maxEventId}</if>
	  	 <if test='minEventId != null'>AND ID >= #{minEventId}</if>
         <if test='id != null'>AND ID = #{id}</if>
         <if test='name != null'>AND LOWER(NAME) LIKE LOWER('%${name}%')</if>
         <if test="levels != null">
				AND EVENT_LEVEL IN
				<foreach item="level" collection="levels" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{level}
				</foreach>
		 </if>
         <if test='startDate != null'>AND DATE_CREATED >= #{startDate}</if>
         <if test='endDate != null'>AND DATE_CREATED <= #{endDate}</if>
         <if test='outcome != null'>AND OUTCOME = #{outcome}</if>
         <if test='userId != null'>AND USER_ID = #{userId}</if>
         <if test='attributeSearch != null'>AND ATTRIBUTES LIKE '%<string>' || #{attributeSearch} || '%'</if>
         <if test='ipAddress != null'>AND IP_ADDRESS = #{ipAddress}</if>
         <if test='serverId != null'>AND UPPER(SERVER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{serverId}) || '%'</if>
      </where>
	</sql>
	
	<select id="getMaxEventId" resultType="Integer">
		SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ID), 0)
		FROM EVENT
	</select>
	
	<select id="searchEvents" parameterType="map" resultMap="event">
		SELECT *
		FROM EVENT
		
		<include refid="searchEventsBody" />
		
		ORDER BY ID desc

		<if test="offset != null">
			OFFSET ${offset} ROWS
		</if>
		<if test="limit != null">
			FETCH FIRST ${limit} ROWS ONLY
		</if>
	</select>
	
	<select id="searchEventsByAsc" parameterType="map" resultMap="event">
		SELECT *
		FROM EVENT
		
		<include refid="searchEventsBody" />
		
		ORDER BY ID asc

		<if test="offset != null">
			OFFSET ${offset} ROWS
		</if>
		<if test="limit != null">
			FETCH FIRST ${limit} ROWS ONLY
		</if>
	</select>
	
	<select id="searchEventsCount" parameterType="map" resultType="long">
		SELECT COUNT(ID)
		FROM EVENT
		
		<include refid="searchEventsBody" />
	</select>
	
	<insert id='insertEvent' parameterType='com.mirth.connect.model.ServerEvent'>
		INSERT INTO
		EVENT (NAME, EVENT_LEVEL, OUTCOME, ATTRIBUTES, USER_ID, IP_ADDRESS, SERVER_ID, DATE_CREATED)
		VALUES (#{name}, #{level}, #{outcome}, #{attributes,typeHandler=MapTypeHandler}, #{userId}, #{ipAddress}, #{serverId}, #{eventTime})
	</insert>
	
	<delete id='deleteAllEvents'>
		DELETE FROM EVENT
	</delete>
</mapper>

instruction: Explain and reproduce this general integration code from server/dbconf/derby/derby-script.xml
output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC '-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN' 'conf/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd'>

<mapper namespace="Script">
	<resultMap type="java.lang.String" id="get-script-result">
		<result property="script" column="SCRIPT" />
	</resultMap>
	
	<select id="getScript" parameterType="java.util.Map" resultMap="get-script-result">
		SELECT SCRIPT
		FROM SCRIPT
		WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND ID = #{id}
	</select>

	<insert id="insertScript" parameterType="java.util.Map">
		INSERT INTO
		SCRIPT (GROUP_ID, ID, SCRIPT)
		VALUES (#{groupId}, #{id}, #{script})
	</insert>

	<update id="updateScript" parameterType="java.util.Map">
		UPDATE SCRIPT
		SET SCRIPT = #{script}
		WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND ID = #{id}
	</update>

	<delete id="deleteScript" parameterType="java.util.Map">
		DELETE FROM SCRIPT
		<where>
			<if test='groupId != null'>GROUP_ID = #{groupId}</if>
			<if test='notGroupId != null'>AND GROUP_ID != #{notGroupId}</if>
		</where>
	</delete>
	
	<update id="lockScriptTable">
		LOCK TABLE SCRIPT IN EXCLUSIVE MODE
	</update>

	<select id="selectMessageForReprocessing" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageContent">

		FROM D_MC${localChannelId}
		WHERE MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}
		AND METADATA_ID = 0
		AND CONTENT_TYPE IN (1, 15)
	</select>
	
	<select id="searchMessageTable" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageTextResult">
		SELECT ID AS MESSAGE_ID
			<if test="includeImportId != null">
				, IMPORT_ID
			</if>
			<if test="includeProcessed != null">
				, PROCESSED
			</if>
			
		FROM D_M${localChannelId} M
		<where>
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="originalIdLower != null">
				AND ORIGINAL_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{originalIdLower}
			</if>
			<if test="originalIdUpper != null">
				AND ORIGINAL_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{originalIdUpper}
			</if>
			<if test="importIdLower != null">
				AND IMPORT_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{importIdLower}
			</if>
			<if test="importIdUpper != null">
				AND IMPORT_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{importIdUpper}
			</if>
			<if test="startDate != null">
				AND RECEIVED_DATE <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{startDate}
			</if>
			<if test="endDate != null">
				AND RECEIVED_DATE <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{endDate}
			</if>
			<if test="serverId != null">
				AND SERVER_ID LIKE '%' + #{serverId} + '%'
			</if>
			<if test="attachment != null and attachment == true">
				AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM D_MA${localChannelId} MA WHERE MA.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID)
			</if>
		</where>
	</select>
	
	<select id="searchMetaDataTable" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageTextResult">
		SELECT MESSAGE_ID AS MESSAGE_ID, ID AS METADATA_ID,
		<choose>
			<when test="textSearch != null">
				CASE WHEN CONNECTOR_NAME LIKE '%' + #{textSearch} + '%' THEN 1
				ELSE 0
				END
			</when>
			<otherwise>
				0
			</otherwise>
		</choose>
		AS TEXT_FOUND
			
		FROM D_MM${localChannelId}
		
		<where>
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="statuses != null">
				AND STATUS IN
				<foreach item="status" collection="statuses" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{status}
				</foreach>
			</if>
			<if test="includedMetaDataIds != null">
				AND ID IN
				<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="includedMetaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{metaDataId}
				</foreach>
			</if>
			<if test="excludedMetaDataIds != null">
				AND ID NOT IN
				<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="excludedMetaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{metaDataId}
				</foreach>
			</if>
			<if test="sendAttemptsLower != null">
				AND SEND_ATTEMPTS <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{sendAttemptsLower}
			</if>
			<if test="sendAttemptsUpper != null">
				AND SEND_ATTEMPTS <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{sendAttemptsUpper}
			</if>
			<if test="error != null and error == true">
				AND ERROR_CODE <![CDATA[ > ]]> 0
			</if>
		</where>
	</select>
	
	<select id="searchCustomMetaDataTable" parameterType="map" resultMap="messageTextResult">
		SELECT MESSAGE_ID AS MESSAGE_ID, METADATA_ID AS METADATA_ID
			
		FROM D_MCM${localChannelId}
		
		<where>
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			<if test="includedMetaDataIds != null">
				AND METADATA_ID IN
				<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="includedMetaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{metaDataId}
				</foreach>
			</if>
			<if test="excludedMetaDataIds != null">
				AND METADATA_ID NOT IN
				<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="excludedMetaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{metaDataId}
				</foreach>
			</if>
			
			<if test="textSearch != null">
				AND 
				
				<foreach item="column" collection="textSearchMetaDataColumns" open="(" separator=" OR " close=")">
					"${column}" LIKE '%' + #{textSearch} + '%'
				</foreach>
			</if>
			
			<if test="metaDataSearch != null">
				<foreach item="element" collection="metaDataSearch">
					AND 
					
					<choose>
						<when test="element.ignoreCase">
							UPPER(${element.columnName})
						</when>
						<otherwise>
							${element.columnName}
						</otherwise>
					</choose>

					<choose>

			</if>

		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>
	
	<delete id="pruneMessageContent" parameterType="map">

		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>
	
	<delete id="pruneCustomMetaData" parameterType="map">

	</delete>

			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				MESSAGE_ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
			
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
	
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
		</where>
	</sql>
	
	<select id="getMessagesToPrune" parameterType="map" resultMap="pruner-message-map">
		<if test="limit != null">
			SELECT A.* FROM (
		</if>
			
			SELECT
				M.ID,
				MM.RECEIVED_DATE AS MM_RECEIVED_DATE,
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY M.ID) AS ROWNUM
			
			FROM D_M${localChannelId} M
			JOIN D_MM${localChannelId} MM ON MM.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID AND MM.ID = 0
			
			<if test="skipStatuses != null">
				LEFT JOIN D_MM${localChannelId} MM_SKIP ON MM_SKIP.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID AND MM_SKIP.STATUS IN
				<foreach item="status" collection="skipStatuses" open="(" separator="," close=")">
					#{status}
				</foreach>
			</if>
		
			WHERE MM.RECEIVED_DATE <![CDATA[ < ]]> #{dateThreshold}
			
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND M.ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				AND M.ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
			
			<if test="skipIncomplete == true">
				AND M.PROCESSED = 1
			</if>
			
			<if test="skipStatuses != null">
				AND MM_SKIP.ID IS NULL
			</if>
			
		<if test="limit != null">
			) AS A WHERE A.ROWNUM <![CDATA[ <= ]]> ${limit}
		</if>
	</select>
	
	<update id="pruneEvents" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM EVENT
		WHERE DATE_CREATED <![CDATA[ < ]]> #{dateThreshold}
	</update>
</mapper>

				AND ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
		</where>
		ORDER BY ID DESC
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageById" resultMap="message">
		SELECT
			ID,
			SERVER_ID,
			RECEIVED_DATE,
			PROCESSED,
			ORIGINAL_ID,
			IMPORT_ID,
			IMPORT_CHANNEL_ID
			
		FROM D_M${localChannelId}
		WHERE ID = #{messageId}
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageContent" resultMap="messageContent">
		SELECT
			METADATA_ID,
			MESSAGE_ID,
			CONTENT_TYPE,
			CONTENT,
			DATA_TYPE,
			ENCRYPTED
			
		FROM D_MC${localChannelId}
		WHERE MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}
		AND METADATA_ID IN
		<foreach item="metaDataId" collection="metaDataIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
			#{metaDataId}
		</foreach>
	</select>
	
	<select id="selectMessageAttachmentIds" parameterType="map" resultType="Attachment">
		SELECT ID, TYPE FROM D_MA${localChannelId}
		WHERE MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}
		GROUP BY ID, TYPE
	</select>
	
	
	
	<!-- Data Pruner/Archiver -->
	
	<delete id="pruneMessages" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_M${localChannelId}
		
		<where>
			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
			
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
	
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				AND ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
		</where>
	</delete>
	
	<delete id="pruneAttachments" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_MA${localChannelId}
		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>
	
	<delete id="pruneMessageContent" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM D_MC${localChannelId}
		<include refid="pruneWhere" />
	</delete>
	
	<sql id="pruneWhere">
		<where>
			<if test="includeMessageList != null">
				MESSAGE_ID IN (${includeMessageList})
			</if>
			
			<if test="maxMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
			</if>
			
			<if test="minMessageId != null">
				AND MESSAGE_ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
			</if>
		</where>
	</sql>
	
	<select id="getMessagesToPrune" parameterType="map" resultMap="pruner-message-map">
		SELECT
			M.ID,
			MM.RECEIVED_DATE AS MM_RECEIVED_DATE
		
		FROM D_M${localChannelId} M
		JOIN D_MM${localChannelId} MM ON MM.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID AND MM.ID = 0
		
		<if test="skipStatuses != null">
			LEFT JOIN D_MM${localChannelId} MM_SKIP ON MM_SKIP.MESSAGE_ID = M.ID AND MM_SKIP.STATUS IN
			<foreach item="status" collection="skipStatuses" open="(" separator="," close=")">
				#{status}
			</foreach>
		</if>
	
		WHERE MM.RECEIVED_DATE <![CDATA[ < ]]> #{dateThreshold}
		
		<if test="maxMessageId != null">
			AND M.ID <![CDATA[ <= ]]> #{maxMessageId}
		</if>
		
		<if test="minMessageId != null">
			AND M.ID <![CDATA[ >= ]]> #{minMessageId}
		</if>
		
		<if test="skipIncomplete == true">
			AND M.PROCESSED = TRUE
		</if>
		
		<if test="skipStatuses != null">
			AND MM_SKIP.ID IS NULL
		</if>
		
		ORDER BY M.ID
		
		<if test="limit != null">
			LIMIT #{limit}
		</if>
	</select>
	
	<update id="pruneEvents" parameterType="map">
		DELETE FROM EVENT
		WHERE DATE_CREATED <![CDATA[ < ]]> #{dateThreshold}
	</update>
</mapper>

```python
import hl7apy

def extract_hospital_service(hl7_message):
    """
    Extracts the hospital service from the PV1 segment of an ADT^A04 message.
    
    Args:
        hl7_message (str): The HL7 v2 message as a string.
        
    Returns:
        str: The hospital service name or None if not found.
    """
    try:
        # Parse the HL7 message
        parsed_message = hl7apy.parse(hl7_message)
        
        # Check if the message type is ADT^A04 (Register a Patient)
        if parsed_message.MSH[9][0] != 'ADT' or parsed_message.MSH[9][1] != 'A04':

        # Locate the PV1 segment
        pv1_segments = parsed_message.get_field('PV1')
        
        if not pv1_segments:
            raise ValueError("No PV1 segments found in the message.")
        
        # Extract the hospital service from the first PV1 segment (assuming one is sufficient)
        for pv1_segment in pv1_segments:
            hospital_service = pv1_segment.get_field('Hospital Service')
            
            if hospital_service:
                return hospital_service[0].value
        
        raise ValueError("No hospital service found in the PV1 segments.")
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error extracting hospital service: {e}")
        return None
```

```python
import re

    """

    Args:
        hl7_message (str): The HL7 message to be parsed.
        
    Returns:
        str: The extracted phone number or None if not found.
    """
    # Split the message by segments
    segments = hl7_message.split('\r')
    
    for segment in segments:
        if segment.startswith('PID'):
            fields = segment.split('|')
            if len(fields) > 13 and fields[13]:
                return fields[13]
                
    return None

def format_phone_number(phone_number):
    """
    Formats the phone number as a standard US phone number.
    
    Args:

    Returns:
        str: The formatted phone number or None if not valid.
    """
    # Remove any non-digit characters
    cleaned_phone = re.sub(r'\D', '', phone_number)
    
    # Check if the cleaned phone number is 10 digits long
    if len(cleaned_phone) != 10:
        return None
    
    # Format the phone number as (XXX) XXX-XXXX
    formatted_phone = f'({cleaned_phone[:3]}) {cleaned_phone[3:6]}-{cleaned_phone[6:]}'
```

```python
def map_to_fhir_patient(hl7_message):

    pd1_segment = hl7_message.get(2, [])
    nk1_segments = hl7_message.get(3, [])

        "identifier": [],
        "name": [],
        "gender": None,
        "birthDate": None,
        "address": [],

    }

        })
        fhir_patient["name"].append({

        fhir_patient["birthDate"] = pid_segment[7][0][1] if pid_segment[7] else None  # PID-7: Date/Time of Birth

    # Map PD1 segment
    for pd1 in pd1_segments:

            fhir_patient["telecom"].append({

    # Map NK1 segments

        if nk1:
            fhir_patient["telecom"].append({

                "value": nk1[4][0][1]  # NK1-4.3: Relationship Phone Number
            })

    return fhir_patient

@app.route('/map-hl7-to-fhir', methods=['POST'])

        parsed_message = parse_hl7_message(hl7_message)
        fhir_patient = map_to_fhir_patient(parsed_message)

        return jsonify(fhir_patient), 200
    except Exception as e:

if __name__ == '__main__':
```

```python
# Function to parse HL7 ORC segment and create a FHIR MedicationRequest resource
def hl7_orc_to_fhir_medication_request(hl7_orc):
    # Extract necessary information from the HL7 ORC segment

        dosageInstruction=[{

                "repeat": {

                    "period": 1,

            }
```

To convert DICOM images to JPEG format and upload them to an AWS S3 bucket, we need to follow these steps:

1. **Receive DICOM files**: This can be done through a Mirth Connect channel.
2. **Convert DICOM to JPEG**: Use a library like `pydicom` to read the DICOM file and `Pillow` (PIL) to convert it to JPEG format.
3. **Upload JPEG to AWS S3**: Use the `boto3` library to upload the converted image to an S3 bucket.

Here's a step-by-step implementation in Python:

### Step 1: Set up Mirth Connect Channel

First, create a Mirth Connect channel that listens for DICOM files and sends them to a script transformer. The script should trigger the conversion and uploading process.

```xml
<channel>
    <name>DICOM to JPEG Upload</name>
    <description>Converts DICOM images to JPEG format and uploads to AWS S3</description>
    <sourceConnector>
        <className>com.mirth.connect.connectors.file.FileReceiver</className>
        <properties>
            <property name="directory">
                <value>/path/to/dicom/files</value>
            </property>
            <property name="fileMask">
                <value>*.dcm</value>
            </property>
            <property name="deleteOnSuccess">
                <value>true</value>
            </property>
        </properties>
    </sourceConnector>
    <destinationConnectors>
        <connector>
            <className>com.mirth.connect.connectors.script.ScriptConnector</className>
            <properties>
                <script>
                    <![CDATA[
                        // Get the DICOM file
                        var dicomFilePath = message['.message'].getMetaDataMap().getString('originalFilename');
                        
                        // Call the Python script to convert and upload
                        var pythonScriptPath = "/path/to/convert_and_upload.py";
                        var args = [dicomFilePath];
                        var process = java.lang.Runtime.getRuntime().exec(['python', pythonScriptPath].concat(args));
                        
                        // Wait for the script to finish
                        process.waitFor();
                    ]]>
                </script>
            </properties>
        </connector>
    </destinationConnectors>
</channel>
```

### Step 2: Python Script for Conversion and Upload

Create a Python script that reads the DICOM file, converts it to JPEG, and uploads it to AWS S3.

```python
import pydicom
from PIL import Image
import io
import boto3
import sys

def dicom_to_jpeg(dicom_path):
    # Read the DICOM file
    ds = pydicom.dcmread(dicom_path)
    
    # Convert to RGB image
    pixel_array = ds.pixel_array
    if ds.PhotometricInterpretation == "MONOCHROME2":
        pixel_array = 255 - pixel_array
    
    # Create an image from the pixel array
    img = Image.fromarray(pixel_array)
    
    # Save the image to a byte buffer in JPEG format
    output_buffer = io.BytesIO()
    img.save(output_buffer, format='JPEG')
    return output_buffer.getvalue()

def upload_to_s3(file_data, bucket_name, object_key):
    s3_client = boto3.client('s3')
    response = s3_client.put_object(Body=file_data, Bucket=bucket_name, Key=object_key)
    return response

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        print("Usage: python convert_and_upload.py <dicom_file_path>")
        sys.exit(1)
    
    dicom_file_path = sys.argv[1]
    jpeg_data = dicom_to_jpeg(dicom_file_path)
    
    # AWS S3 configuration
    bucket_name = 'your-s3-bucket-name'
    object_key = f'uploads/{dicom_file_path.split("/")[-1].replace(".dcm", ".jpg")}'
    
    response = upload_to_s3(jpeg_data, bucket_name, object_key)
    print("Upload response:", response)
```

instruction: Write a Python script to parse incoming DICOM messages, extract patient demographics from the Patient Demographics Message (PDQ Query/Response), and then update the patient's record in the healthcare system using the RESTful API endpoint `/api/patient/update`. The script should handle different event types by routing them to specific processing functions. Ensure that all required fields such as Patient ID (PID-3) are present before making the API call.
output:
To implement this solution, we need to follow these steps:

1. **Receive DICOM Messages**: We'll use a DICOM server to receive incoming messages.
2. **Parse DICOM Messages**: Extract patient demographics from the PDQ Query/Response message.
3. **Validate Required Fields**: Ensure that all required fields (like Patient ID) are present.
4. **Route Events**: Direct events to specific processing functions based on their type.
5. **Update Patient Record**: Make a RESTful API call to update the patient's record.

Here is a Python script that accomplishes this:

```python
import pydicom
import requests

# Define constants for DICOM tags and API endpoint
DICOM_PID_TAG = (0x0038, 0x0019)  # Patient ID tag in PDQ Query/Response
API_ENDPOINT = "https://your-healthcare-system.com/api/patient/update"

def parse_dicom_message(dicom_file):
    """Parse DICOM message and extract patient demographics."""
    ds = pydicom.dcmread(dicom_file)
    
    if 'PatientID' not in ds:
        raise ValueError("Patient ID is missing from the DICOM message.")
    
    patient_id = ds.PatientID
    patient_name = ds.PatientName if 'PatientName' in ds else None
    birth_date = ds.PatientBirthDate if 'PatientBirthDate' in ds else None
    
    return {
        "patient_id": patient_id,
        "patient_name": patient_name,
        "birth_date": birth_date
    }

def update_patient_record(patient_data):
    """Update the patient's record using the RESTful API."""
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    
    response = requests.post(API_ENDPOINT, json=patient_data, headers=headers)
    
    if response.status_code == 200:
        print("Patient record updated successfully.")
    else:
        raise Exception(f"Failed to update patient record: {response.text}")

def process_event(event_type, dicom_file):
    """Route events to specific processing functions."""
    try:
        patient_data = parse_dicom_message(dicom_file)
        
        if event_type == "PDQ_QUERY_RESPONSE":
            update_patient_record(patient_data)
        else:
            print(f"Unhandled event type: {event_type}")
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error processing event: {e}")

# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    dicom_file = "path/to/dicom/file.dcm"
    event_type = "PDQ_QUERY_RESPONSE"  # or another event type
    
    process_event(event_type, dicom_file)
```

### Explanation:

1. **DICOM Parsing**:
   - The `parse_dicom_message` function reads the DICOM file using `pydicom` and extracts patient demographics.
   - It checks if the required `PatientID` tag is present.

2. **API Call**:
   - The `update_patient_record` function makes a POST request to the specified API endpoint with the patient data in JSON format.
   - It handles different HTTP status codes to ensure the update was successful.

3. **Event Routing**:
   - The `process_event` function routes events based on their type (`PDQ_QUERY_RESPONSE` in this case).
   - It calls the appropriate processing function and handles any exceptions that occur during parsing or API call.
